notes: HEFSP adopted by New Milford Planning Board on May 20, 2025. Present need of 14 accepted from DCA. Prospective need settled at 110 (borough proposed 108; NJBA challenged upward; settled at 110). Fourth Round RDP = 6 (VLA); unmet need = 104. Primary Fourth Round site is the ShopRite/bank redevelopment at Block 501, Lots 9 and 10 (River Road), yielding net 5 new credits plus 2.5 bonus = 7.5 total toward the 6-unit RDP. Remaining unmet need addressed through general inclusionary zoning requirement (adopted 2018, amended 2019) applicable to large-scale redevelopment. Present need addressed via Bergen County Rehabilitation Program. Third Round prospective need was 288 units; RDP was 27; unmet need was 261. Third Round obligation (23 units) addressed with 3 surplus credits. Prior round group homes (Advanced Housing, Center for Family Support, NIPD) counted as Third Round credits. The Nest (Block 104, Lot 18, 1070 River Road) completed 2020 with 4 affordable rental units.
